crossRefs.note: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.
Further, because the Preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge. Yes, he pondered, sought out, and set in…
When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people…
My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you, that you…
They will do these things because they have not known the Father, nor me.
For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.
This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,
for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.
He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.
The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.
Don’t be hasty in bringing charges to court. What will you do in the end when your neighbor shames you?
A stingy man hurries after riches, and doesn’t know that poverty waits for him.
“If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hurried to deceit
Don’t be hasty in your spirit to be angry, for anger rests in the bosom of fools.
Therefore the Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious cornerstone…

translations.web: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge, nor being hasty with one’s feet and missing the way.
translations.bsb: Even zeal is no good without knowledge, and he who hurries his footsteps misses the mark.
translations.kjv: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.
translations.asv: Also, that the soul be without knowledge is not good; And he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.
